title: ui: the action text localizer resolves `description`, so an inline action's param dialog shows it in the user's language (cloud#3281 ruling A, half 2 of 2)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate: executing a recorded ruling. objectstack-ai/cloud#3281 was ruled **A** by the maintainer (「3281 A 3138 A」, 2026-10-26, ruling comment 6408789175). This is the ui half; the spec half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#29248 and lands first.

## What happens

Once an inline action can declare a `description` as an `I18nLabel` (a locale map), the console must collapse it to one string before `ActionParamDialog` shows it. Today the localizer does not touch `description`, so a locale map would reach the dialog unresolved, or the dialog falls back to the generic 「请填写以下信息以继续操作。」.

## Where (objectstack `main` `0c0d3b68e1`)

`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts`, around line 129: `const DECLARED_COPY_KEYS = ['confirmText', 'successMessage', 'errorMessage'] as const;`. `elements.tsx` already forwards `description` to the dialog.

## Ask

- `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS` gains `description`, and the doc comment above `ActionTextLocalizer` names it.
- Tests: an inline action with a zh-CN/en `description` map shows the active locale's string in the param dialog; an action with no `description` still shows the generic line.

## Business reason

The console's invitation dialog is the one place a new owner invites a colleague. It should say what happens next in the owner's language.

## Order

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#29248 (the spec half). After both land, cloud bumps its pins and gives `INVITE_ACTION` the framework action's `description` in four locales (cloud#3281).

## Dedup

Searched objectstack issues and PRs for "DECLARED_COPY_KEYS description", "InlineActionSchema description" and "cloud#3281": nothing open or merged.
